home_prompt: What would you like to do?
welcome: OVManager {role} · {username} Use the menu below, or type a username to find someone. Creating a user is a short conversation — no slash commands needed.
denied:
This Telegram account is not linked to OVManager.

Ask the panel owner to add your Telegram ID under Settings → Bot (owner) or Admin management (operators).
rate_limited: You're going a bit fast. Wait a moment and try again.
unknown_action: That action is no longer available.
error: Something went wrong. Try again from the menu.
users_empty: No users yet. Tap {new} to create the first one.
users_hint: Tap a name, or type one to search.
user_gone: That user is no longer available.
search_none: No user matching {query}. Type another name, or open the Users list.
search_prompt: Type the username — or the first few letters.
create_hint_suggest: Suggested name from your prefix: {name} Send that, type another name, or tap the button below.
create_hint_type: Type a username (3–64 letters, numbers or underscores).
create_start: Creating a user. Tap Cancel to stop.
create_custom_days:
Custom plan — how many days should this user last?
Send 0 for no expiry.
create_custom_traffic: How many GB of traffic? Send 0 for unlimited.
create_custom_logins: How many simultaneous devices? Send 0 for unlimited.
create_use_buttons: Use the buttons below, or tap Cancel.
create_no_prefix:
No username prefix is configured for your account.
Type a name instead.
create_bad_name: That name isn't valid. Use 3–64 letters, numbers or underscores, no spaces.
create_pick_plan: Username {name}. Choose a plan, or tap Custom to set the numbers yourself.
create_ok_list: Created {name}. Open Users to see the card.
delete_ask: Delete {name}? They will be removed from every node. You can undo this from the panel for a couple of minutes.
sub_missing: No subscription URL is configured on the panel.
dl_fail: Could not generate the config. Check that the node is online and the user is active.
lang_title: Language Same languages as the panel. Pick one — the menu updates immediately.
session_expired: Session expired — tap again to continue with a fresh session.
panel_unreachable: Panel is unreachable. Try again in a moment.
restore_fail: Could not restore (the undo window may have expired).
edit_value_expiry: New expiry in days from today (1–3650):
